POLIS V6/SOFTWARE DELIVERY

Code evolves.
Evidence remains.

A protocol and CLI that turn code changes into verifiable, traceable deliveries applied under explicit control. From requirements to artifacts, backed by evidence rather than promises.

What makes POLIS different?
SPEC → EVIDENCE → DELIVERY
PRINCIPLES

More than running tests.
Proving the process.

POLIS connects requirements, development proof, validation policies, and identifiable code changes.

01 / SCOPE

Contracts before code

Every change begins with defined requirements, acceptance criteria, file scope, and proof.

Explore contracts ↗
02 / EVIDENCE

Reproducible validation

Gates, Red/Green proof, input identity, and explicit PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED outcomes.

Explore validation ↗
03 / CONSUMPTION

Controlled application

The consumer checks the package in its own environment before authorizing changes.

Understand preflight and apply ↗
HOW IT WORKS

One process. Two responsibilities.

The producer builds the delivery and its evidence. The consumer decides whether it can be accepted in the target repository.

View full workflow →

Note: capture-red is required for Red-to-Green workflows; behavior-preserving changes follow Green-to-Green. The implementation plan is optional. Learn more.

GETTING STARTED

Your terminal.
Your control.

Install the CLI to begin. doctor checks your environment; init generates project policy; plan previews how validation will run.

Full installation guide →
Recommended installation
# Requires Go 1.23+ and Git
go install github.com/MarcosAlves90/polis/v6/cmd/polis@latest

# Verify installation
polis doctor

# Explore your validation configuration
polis init --repo . --dry-run
polis plan --repo .
